findings.statement: Sizes run from tiny-1k to large-1m, and the developers give a suggested GPU for each: tiny-1k runs on a T4 for pretraining, fine-tuning and inference.
findings.source_says: The card's "GPU requirements (suggested)" list covers five checkpoints only: tiny-1k (T4, T4, T4), small-32k, medium-160k, medium-450k and large-1m. tiny-1k-d256 and tiny-16k-d128, which the README also lists, have no suggestion.
findings.fix: Sizes run from tiny-1k to large-1m, and the model card suggests a GPU for five of the seven checkpoints: tiny-1k runs on a T4 for pretraining, fine-tuning and inference.

summary: Reliable. Checkpoint names, context lengths, licences and commands match the README, model card, huggingface.py script, licence and API response; one strength says GPU suggestions exist for every size when the card covers five of seven.
